sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000130-P1, was presented by the Supplier to Silver Oak Medical Group 130 on September 14, 2024.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 1.25%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Influenza share floor of 45%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: accepted by the Customer.
